jobs.description: The other public bulk files of the data.go.kr file data (root ADR-0401; scripts/ops/data-go-kr-file-data-cycle.sh). Collect: for every file of data-go-kr-file-data.contract.json but the registered factory (its own job collects it), ask the portal once which file is current and, only when it is new, land it in Bronze under its own source (datagokr__<dataset_slug>); each file commits on its own. Load: plan-silver-load-objects names, per table, the Bronze files no commit of its table records, and one Spark run loads each into silver.<dataset_slug>: the header and encoding checked against the contract, one row per line keyed by the provider key or the row's SHA-256 with every raw column kept, linked by the contract's place_link (address_pnu, the place-identity resolver, 법정동 names, or the 행정동 code), and only new or changed keys and removal markers appended. The Spark run happens every day: when reference.legal_dong_code_change moved since a table's last linking, only the rows under the changed codes (and the unlinked ones) are linked again (ADR-0329 §3). Measured 2026-11-04: all eight files new is about 365 MB (the 349 MB 상가(상권) zip in 59 s); staging the 2,753,778 상가 rows took 62 s and building their keys and raw columns 77 s on a 4-core laptop, so a first run of all eight fits well inside the limit. The three 표준데이터 (school location, university, subway station) come through the dataset page's own keyless download (root ADR-0453): the current table and its column list, then every page of a pass, landed only when its rows changed; the OpenAPI is only a cross-check when a registered key is set. Their per-run cap is max_pages in the contract (3, 1 and 1 pages of 10,000): measured 2026-11-09, a pass of all three is 12,004, 1,995 and 898 rows in 4 pages plus 3 column lists, about 9.1 MB of JSON (1 MB gzipped) and under 2 s of answers, about 35 s with the 5 s spacing, so the limit holds. Three files a broker shows a buyer joined on 2026-11-11 (the W68 data landscape): 표준지공시지가 (139.5 MB CSV, 600,000 rows), 승강기 설치 현황 (33 MB zip, 893,715 rows) and 전국지식산업센터현황 (0.1 MB, 1,549 rows), so a run that finds every file new lands about 538 MB; the 표준지 file is yearly and the other two irregular, so a usual run lands none of them. A failed collection still lets the load run for the files that landed; the run fails at the end.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the description's 2026-11-04 measurement: all eight files new about 365 MB (the 349 MB zip in 59 s), staging 2,753,778 rows 62 s and their keys and raw columns 77 s on a 4-core laptop, and the three standard datasets about 35 s (2026-11-09); 1,800 s leaves the Spark start and the place linking about ten times that; the three files added 2026-11-11 add about 173 MB to download (the 상가 zip of 349 MB took 59 s, so about 30 s at that rate) and 1,495,264 rows, about half the 상가 rows, to stage and link; 2,700 s keeps the same margin inside the 90-minute limit

expected_outcome.basis: its files are released monthly at the most often (school locations, household counts, population: expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h; the rest quarterly, yearly or irregular) plus one daily turn.

assets.title: data.go.kr 파일 매일 확인
assets.description: 계약의 파일마다 하루 한 번 확인한다(루트 ADR-0401 §1). 포털 파일은 메타데이터를 묻고 파일 id(atchFileId)가 새로울 때만 받고, 표준데이터는 데이터셋 페이지의 키 없는 내려받기로 쪽을 전부 읽어(루트 ADR-0453) 행이 지난 판과 다를 때만 그 원천의 Bronze(datagokr__<dataset_slug>)에 남긴다. 파일마다 따로 커밋한다. 등록공장은 작업 registered_factory 가, 나머지 11개는 작업 data_go_kr_file_data 가 받는다.
